name: Four Points Shopping Centre
summary: Four Points Shopping Centre is a highly-rated neighborhood shopping center in northwest Austin's Four Points area, serving the affluent communities near Lake Travis. With a 4.7-star rating and convenient location on FM 620, it provides essential retail and services to the rapidly growing residential areas of Steiner Ranch and River Place.
demographics: Four Points Shopping Centre serves an affluent demographic in northwest Austin, with visitors primarily consisting of upper-middle to high-income families and professionals residing in nearby master-planned communities like Steiner Ranch and River Place. The trade area is characterized by well-educated households with above-average incomes, typically ranging from $100,000 to $200,000+ annually, with a mix of young families, established professionals, and active retirees. Shoppers in this area tend to prioritize convenience and quality, seeking everyday necessities, professional services, and dining options close to home, with a preference for well-maintained centers that reflect the upscale character of their neighborhoods.
description: Four Points Shopping Centre is a well-established neighborhood retail destination located in the desirable Four Points area of northwest Austin, Texas. Situated at 7301 North FM 620, this shopping center serves the rapidly growing communities of Steiner Ranch, River Place, and the surrounding Lake Travis area. With an impressive 4.7-star rating from over 150 Google reviews, the center has earned a strong reputation among local residents for its convenient location and quality tenant mix. The shopping center provides essential retail and service options for the affluent residential neighborhoods that characterize this part of Austin, offering a comfortable and accessible shopping experience. Managed by ShopCore Properties, Four Points Shopping Centre continues to be a valued community asset in one of Austin's most sought-after suburban areas.
